question: When did the ElastiCache for Redis Multi-AZ SLA rise to 99.99%, and what was it before?

values.spoken: an SLA of ninety-nine point nine nine percent
an SLA of ninety-nine point nine percent for Multi-AZ

qualifiers.condition: announced in the What's New post dated 2023-01-31

evidence.quote: Amazon Elasticache for Redis now offers an availability Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 99.99% when using a Multi-Availability Zone (Multi-AZ) configuration. Previously, ElastiCache for Redis offered an SLA of 99.9% for Multi-AZ configurations.

changed.was: an SLA of 99.9% for Multi-AZ configurations

note: Current truth: the ElastiCache SLA page and the deployment options page give 99.99% for Multi-AZ node-based configurations and for ElastiCache Serverless. Older material and older exam questions may say 99.9%.

claim: ElastiCache announced support for Service Quotas, which provides improved visibility and control over ElastiCache service quotas.
question: Are ElastiCache quotas managed in Service Quotas?

evidence.quote: Today, Amazon ElastiCache announces support for Service Quotas. This enhancement provides customers with improved visibility and control over their ElastiCache service quotas, streamlining the quota management process and reducing the need for manual interventions.

note: Dated 2025-01-15 in the change feed. Current truth: the quotas guide page says to open the Service Quotas console, in the navigation pane choose AWS services and select ElastiCache.
